model.name: OtmuxBridge.readSessionTree
model.description: execFile('tmux',['list-panes','-a','-F', ...]) (args array, no shell — injection-safe), parse into nested sessions/windows/panes JSON with pane_id + human label session:win.pane so the owner IDs the agent pane. Read-only, never mutates tmux; refreshable via re-call. Owner-gated (R31.2). R31.3. Design-ahead, no impl yet.
